description: It was great to be in New York City for this week’s Monday Meeting and have the opportunity to speak about our campaign for Congress. I shared why I’m running, the priorities that matter most to families across the Hudson Valley, and the work we’re doing to build a campaign focused on affordability, accountability, and opportunity. Thank you to everyone who took the time to listen, connect, and support our campaign. We’re just getting started! 🇺🇸
